mapping_scheme_readonly_tip: The mixing assumption is determined by the loaded configuration file and cannot be changed manually. Internal and external mixing have different fraction table structures and computation logic — load the corresponding cfg type.
mixing_scheme_readonly_tip: The mixing assumption is determined by the loaded configuration file and cannot be changed manually. Internal and external mixing have different fraction table structures and computation logic — load the corresponding cfg type.
about_text: Standalone internal/external mixing comparison GUI for SCRAM.
about_text_full: SCRAM BoxApp is a workflow-oriented scientific desktop app for comparing internal and external mixing assumptions and their effects on aerosol size, composition, and mixing state. It provides bilingual UI, structured table editing, live runtime monitoring, summary-driven results browsing, and Chinese PDF report export.
experiment_name_hint: Results are saved under single/ or compare/ as 「experiment_name_case_preset」. Reusing the same name overwrites previous results.
custom_config_desc: Custom configuration loaded from an external .cfg file. Parameters may differ from built-in presets — review all tabs before running.
nearest_note: External mixing resolves particles in size-composition cells and can distinguish mixed and unmixed particles within the same size section.
legacy_note: Internal mixing assumes one average composition per size section; it is faster but does not resolve composition diversity among particles.
sulfate_computation_tip: 0 = normal (handled by bulk equilibrium); 1 = explicit dynamic solve (calls SULFDYN). The core only tests 0/1; any other value is treated as 0.
redistribution_method_tip: SCRAM1.2 semantics: 0/1 skip size redistribution entirely; with the default kernel every value >= 2 is equivalent (all go through moving_center_dualpivot, so 2/3/4/5/6 give bit-identical results). Only when the kernel above is switched to legacy do the old meanings return: 2 = moving diameter, 3 = euler_mass, 4 = euler_number, 5 = hemen, 6 = euler_coupled (note: legacy + 6 reproduces the upstream number non-conservation).
redistribution_option_tip: Passed to the core as the SCRAM_REDISTRIBUTION_MODE environment variable (new in SCRAM1.2, and actually read by the core). moving_center_dualpivot = the 1.2 kernel (default); legacy = restore the old kernel and the old method-number meanings.
nucl_model_tip: 1 = sulfate-ammonia-water ternary nucleation; 5 = hard-coded validation mode (ignores the species data in the config and uses the hazy parameterisation plus a constant sulfate source). Any other value means nucleation never happens, even with Enable nucleation checked.
dynamic_solver_tip: 0 = euler / 1 = ETR / 2 = ROS2. The core only tests these three values and has no else branch -- 3-9 calls no solver at all, the sub-step clock never advances and the core hangs. The run is now blocked up-front. SCRAM1.2 did not change this item.
kind_grid_tip: 0 = auto-generate logarithmic size bounds (the Size bins table is ignored); 1 = use the manually entered Size bins table (factory default).
cut_dim_tip: Sections below this diameter additionally get a bulk inorganic equilibrium solve after every step; sections above it only follow the dynamic solver. Internally the core locates the section containing this diameter to obtain ICUT; if it is <= the smallest bound then ICUT = 0 (i.e. nothing happens). Note: factory templates set 0, which means NO inorganic equilibrium; raising it above 0.001 opens a path the factory config never exercised, so results will change.
init_scenario_tip: Has an effect only when tag_init = 0 in the config (derive the initial state from the three built-in scene distributions). Factory templates all use tag_init = 1 (use the per-bin masses written in the config), so the choice makes no difference. nucl_model = 5 also bypasses this through its hard-coded branch.
structure_help: Set species count, size bins and fraction sections, then click 「Generate Structure」 to create empty tables. After editing table values, click 「Rebuild Tables」 to sync changes to the config preview. Note: 「Generate Structure」 clears and recreates all tables — edited data will be lost.
runtime_missing: No ProgramSCRAM compatible with the current platform was found. On Linux, provide a native ELF build or set SCRAM_PROGRAMSCRAM to the executable path.
cannot_remove_species: At least one species must remain.
